Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment

For 522 N Sawyer Ave, Chicago, IL 60624
From a B3-1 District to an RT-4 District

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from a B3-1 Community Shopping District
to that of an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District in
order to meet the bulk and density standards of the RT-4 zoning district to allow
the applicant to rehab and bring the existing non-conforming 3-flat property into
compliance after it was recently removed from PD 836. The property will
continue to operate as a 2-story with basement 3 dwelling-unit property with no
parking spaces, no commercial space, and the existing height of 20’ — 0” will
remain unchanged.
